title: 3-D transient conduction in a cube (T11c), Robin faces on all three, EXACT tier
capability_grid_cell: conduction x laminar (no flow) x 3D -- reads `CAN NOT DO -- not attempted` at HEAD cbcb1127 (docs/capability/heat-transfer_GRID.md:49)
ceiling: GATE REACHED at best. The reference is an EXACT series solution, so under the upheld V/P ruling this rung scores V and NEVER P; it can never reach HOLDS. Stated here so a reader does not discover it at grading.
turbulence: NONE -- this is a solid-conduction case with no fluid and no closure. The registered closure was checked against the required field set explicitly: laplacianFoam solves for T alone, writes T alone, and reads no turbulenceProperties; the field tuple is therefore ('T',) and requires no k, epsilon, omega, nut or alphat. A registration that required omega here could never complete (the K0d defect, 829 core-min).

G1.quantity: theta_mean, arithmetic mean over the octant's equal-volume cell centres (the midpoint rule; NOT mesh-independent -- its own quadrature error is computed below)
G1.grading: Roache triple, rule 5; the FINE value is graded, the extrapolate is reported beside it and gated on never
G1.band_ground: Two components, both computed BEFORE compute. (a) READER: applying this comparator's own reader to the EXACT field at each level's cell centres gives +2.361e-04 (N=20), +5.903e-05 (N=40), +1.476e-05 (N=80) -- exactly O(1/N^2), ratio 4.000. (b) FINITE VOLUME: T11 measured +4.4e-06 total at N=100 on the 1-D mean (T11_PREREGISTRATION.md 6.1); this module computes the 1-D midpoint-reader component at N=100 as +3.148e-06, leaving +1.25e-06 as T11's FV component, which scales to +1.95e-06 at N=80 and triples across the product to +5.9e-06. PREDICTED FINE DEVIATION +2.06e-05. The band 5e-05 is cleared by the fine level by 2.4x and is FAILED by the medium level (predicted +8.2e-05) -- a 1e-03 band would be cleared by every level and would not be a gate.

G2.quantity: theta at (x*,y*,z*) = (0,0,0), the centre of the full cube, separable linear extrapolation from the nearest cell centres in each direction
G2.grading: Roache triple, rule 5; FINE value graded
G2.band_ground: READER component on the EXACT field: +1.615e-03 (N=20), +4.030e-04 (N=40), +1.007e-04 (N=80) -- the linear extrapolation to a symmetry plane is O(1/N^2) and dominates. FV component estimated at the same order as G1's (~2e-05; the pointwise FV error is NOT separately measured anywhere in this family and this estimate is the weakest number in this registration -- it is named as such). PREDICTED FINE DEVIATION ~+1.2e-04; band 2.5e-04 clears the fine level by ~2.1x and is FAILED by the medium level (~+4.5e-04).

G3.quantity: theta at (x*,y*,z*) = (1,0,0), the centre of one Robin face on the two symmetry planes, separable linear extrapolation
G3.grading: Roache triple, rule 5; FINE value graded
G3.band_ground: READER component on the EXACT field: +2.023e-03 (N=20), +5.018e-04 (N=40), +1.250e-04 (N=80). FV component estimated as for G2. PREDICTED FINE DEVIATION ~+1.45e-04; band 3.0e-04 clears the fine level by ~2.1x and is FAILED by the medium level (~+5.6e-04).

C_CONV.what: every timestep's T solve final residual <= 1e-10 and an End line (gate (1) for a transient rung, T11/T14 form)

W0.what: permutation-symmetry witness: max |theta(i,j,k) - theta(j,i,k)|, |theta(i,j,k) - theta(i,k,j)|, |theta(i,j,k) - theta(k,j,i)| <= the floor on every level. The continuous and the discrete problem are both invariant under any permutation of the axes; exceeding the floor means solver or reader asymmetry -> gate (1) NOT A RESULT. THE FLOOR IS 1e-07, NOT 1e-09: the DIC preconditioner factorises in lexicographic cell order, which is not axis-symmetric, so a benign round-off drift over 20 000 timesteps is expected and must not void a rung. On fields of order 0.3-0.9 a floor of 1e-07 is still a 3e-07 relative check and catches any real asymmetry. The SHARP expectation is registered as prediction P4, which can lose.

C_VF.what: valueFraction on each level READ FROM CASE.txt must equal Bi/(Bi+2N) (L-341); refuses otherwise. The three registered levels give 2.439024e-02 / 1.234568e-02 / 6.211180e-03 -- all different, as L-341 requires.

C_REF.what: Route B on the referent (3-D PDE residual at two stencil widths falling as h^2, three symmetry planes, three Robin faces, initial condition, permutation symmetry, Simpson mean) plus TWO CROSS-CHECKS to 1e-9 against numbers this module did not compute: T11's registered 1-D values and T14's registered 2-D values. A 1e-7 mutation of C_n is REFUSED by the cross-checks (exact_t18.py --selftest).

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control per reader (rule 3, L-340): ALL-CELL plant for the averaging reader G1 (N_f^3 = 512 000 cells), one-cell plant for the point readers G2 (index 0) and G3 (index N_f-1); both arms; measured detection ladder; refuses a blind or noisy reader or a read below 0.1 x plant

C_T.what: temporal-bias control: T18_CU_f_CT, deltaT halved at the fine level; movement of G1 REPORTED as a fraction of the band, never gated

predictions.P1: G1, G2, G3 all PASS: G1 inside +-5e-05 relative, G2 inside +-2.5e-04, G3 inside +-3.0e-04. CAN LOSE -- the FV component of G2/G3 is an estimate, not a measurement.
predictions.P2: all three triples CONVERGING with observed order p in [1.7, 2.3]. CAN LOSE -- the reader error and the FV error are both nominally second order but they are not the same error and their sum need not be a clean power law.
predictions.P3: C-T moves G1 by less than 20 percent of the G1 band (|move| < 1e-05 relative). Ground: implicit-Euler global relative error on a mode decaying at rate lambda per unit Fo is lambda^2 dFo Fo / 2; with lambda = zeta_1^2 = 0.7401, dFo = 1e-05, Fo = 0.2 that is 5.5e-07 per factor, 1.6e-06 across the product; halving deltaT halves it, so the measured move should be about 8e-07. CAN LOSE.
predictions.P4: W0 < 1e-09 on every level (sharper than the 1e-07 gate floor). CAN LOSE -- DIC's lexicographic ordering is not axis-symmetric and 20 000 timesteps of round-off may exceed it; a loss here is REPORTED as a wrong prediction and does not by itself void the rung, because the gate floor is 1e-07.

cost.rate_provenance: BORROWED, NOT MEASURED ON THIS RUNG. The number is T14's rate, MEASURED 2026-08-26T21:03Z on a scratch copy of T14_SQ_c: laplacianFoam, Euler, Gauss linear corrected, PCG/DIC 1e-12, serial, 2 500 cells, 2 000 steps, ExecutionTime 0.82 s (T14_registered.json cost.rate_scratch_measured_core_s_per_cell_step, and T14_PREREGISTRATION.md section 7). SAME SOLVER FAMILY (laplacianFoam, identical schemes and linear solver), SAME steady/transient class.
cost.misprediction_risk: NAMED AND ONE-SIDED. The rate is borrowed across (a) a dimension change 2-D -> 3-D, which raises the stencil from 4 neighbours to 6 and roughly doubles the flux work per cell, and (b) a mesh jump 2 500 -> 512 000 cells, which leaves cache and raises the PCG iteration count as the condition number grows with N. A rate borrowed across a mesh jump made T1b L4 miss by 31.4 percent. The expected miss here is an UNDER-prediction by a factor of up to about 3; the caps are set at 4.3x to 6.9x the point precisely to absorb it. If the actual exceeds the cap the run STOPS and does not get a new budget (rule 12). No scratch rate probe was run for this registration because the lane that wrote it was instructed to launch no solver.
cost.usd_basis: DERIVED, NOT MEASURED. The box cannot read its own billing (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER section 5); the rate is owner-stated 2026-08-21/22.
cost.calibration: a row in docs/COST_CALIBRATION.md is owed at completion, stating actual/predicted and attributing the gap (rule 12)

completion.rule: CLAUDE.md rule 4, all-or-nothing: rc=0 in the wrapper-written STATUS; an End line; last written time == endTime; the registered field present at that time; ExecutionTime line count == endTime/deltaT; every field at endTime NEWER than the case's own 0/T (age guard)
